## B.5 N11 — FAILED on live evidence (defect found; fix landed in tree)

Browser walk of `/p/jrn-7e6d14996693-cite1/review/01M48YYS50Z6CNX517RJQXRCJ2`
(`scripts/live/cite1-evidence.mjs`, magic-link storageState):

```json
{"total":7,"uncovered":2,"chips":5,"evidenceLis":6,"stamped":6,"verdictRows":6}
```

2 of 7 cited source URLs render chip-less (`data-url-in-log="false"`) while persisted completeness
says 7/7 covered — **N11 stays red**. The two URLs:

- `https://www.williamrinehart.com/2022/broadband-mapping-machine-learning/`
- `https://broadbandmappingcoalition.org/assessing-available-databases-fcc-form-477/`

**Root cause (two-sided):**
1. *Write:* `packages/mirror/src/delivery.ts` stored `claim_sources.normalized_url` from the model
   blob verbatim — the trailing-slash form — while the log-side set is canonical.
2. *Read:* `packages/findings-core/src/ledger.ts` `claimUrlViews` passed `s.normalizedUrl` into
   `fetchLog.has()` raw (only the singular `claim.url` was folded through `canonicalNormalizeUrl`).
   `fetchLogFromRows` canonicalizes log rows, so the sets diverged byte-for-byte on exactly the two
   trailing-slash sources.

**Fix (in this commit):** `claimUrlViews` now folds every `sources[]` normalizedUrl through the
canonical function; `delivery.ts` persists the canonical form. Regression test added
(`ledger.test.ts` — trailing-slash source joins the canonical log). This is the exact parity-drift
class CITE.1 exists to catch — found by the live N11 walk, not by the scan. **The fix is in-tree,
not yet deployed; N11 re-verify against the Leg-3 dossier rides the next prod deploy.**

### D.1 Harness repairs landed this session (trivially-safe legs only — no product code touched)

- `tailSse` (B17's live SSE tail) starved every chunk after the first >4 s idle gap: the
  `Promise.race([reader.read(), 4 s])` ABANDONED the pending read on timeout, and a
  `ReadableStream` reader queues pending reads — every later chunk resolved an abandoned promise
  whose value was dropped. Fix: exactly one in-flight read, kept across iterations; the 4 s race
  only re-checks `stop()`. Verified: a raw probe on a completed run held the stream 40 s with the
  25 s `: ping` — the api's replay-then-tail is healthy (`sse-routes.ts` / `event-stream.ts`);
  the defect was client-side only.
- `openFindingsDesk` retried the ⌘J/Control-j drawer chord (≤3×, 4 s each): the island hydrates
  after `domcontentloaded`, so a chord pressed too early was swallowed and the leg then clicked
  the desk tab strip while it was clipped by the closed drawer under `footer.ide-statusbar`
  (T11's earlier "statusbar occlusion" was this — NOT a product defect).
- T14's obligation leg now selects only findings whose chip is a LIVE obligation state
  (`open`/`reopened`); a `discharged_pending` (mooted) chip still renders on the card and
  deferring it 500s (see D.5, finding F-S5b-1).

### D.5 Defects / findings recorded this window (nothing fixed in product code)

- **F-S5b-1 — disposition `defer` on a finding whose obligation is `mooted`/closed → HTTP 500
  `internal_error` (requestId `5796fa21f754cc83b6150fe7c87d859e`).** `recordDispositionInTx`
  routes the obligation whenever the finding has one; `routeDisposition`'s same-target no-op only
  covers an identical terminal state, so `mooted → deferred` reaches the closed-world transition
  and throws `ObligationTransitionError` unmapped. Should be a clean 4xx/no-op. → new deferral row
  D-STB.5b-4.
- **F-S5b-2 — `outline` workflow runs die `phase_blocked` on empty-text `sdk=success` — twice
  consecutively (spine, then gaps), non-retryable.** Terminal-by-design per internal-api.ts:1287,
  but an empty-text success producing a non-retryable run death is a fragility finding for the
  outline manifest/scoped-query path. → new deferral row D-STB.5b-5.
- **N5 queue-depth boundary** — a paid leg launched while the worker fleet is saturated by the
  same window's earlier legs queued 35 min; the 40-min delivery poll is now known to need
  queue+execute slack (a harness-budget note, not a product defect).
